headline: ⏸️ THE BOARD YOU ARE READING AT 5:35 IS THE BOARD YOU LEFT AT 8 THIS MORNING — THE FLEET WENT DARK FOR NINE HOURS OF A WORKING TUESDAY. The last routine to log anything was the 8:0x team board; nothing ran again until 5:05 PM. The call sweep, which fires every twenty to thirty minutes, stopped after 7:40 AM and missed roughly eighteen turns. ⭐ NOTHING WAS LOST — no lead vanished and no mail bounced — but nine hours of a working day produced zero machine work, and all eight cards The Daily built for you this morning are still unchecked. 🔥 THE ONE THING THAT DID MOVE MOVED WITHOUT US: at 3:01 this afternoon a third agent booked 2127 Hwy 93 — the reprice to $999,000 has now produced THREE bookings in thirty hours on a house that drew two tours in the forty days before it. · DO: call Mike H. — the day's one unchecked card · DECIDE: the Just Sold post — our 44 days, or a straight celebration · WATCH: the card behind your business email declined again this morning.

notes: 🔴 NINE HOURS OF A WORKING TUESDAY WITH ZERO FLEET ACTIVITY — 8:0x AM to 5:05 PM, not one routine logged a line. The morning ran normally and on schedule (marketing 5:25, money 5:5x, equity 5:55, triage 6:0x, The Daily 7:3x, amplifier 7:5x, team board 8:0x), and then it simply stopped. ⭐ THE SHAPE OF IT IS THE DIAGNOSIS: routines do not run when the app is closed, so this is a machine-was-off gap, not a broken routine — nothing needs fixing, but nothing got done either. The call sweep alone missed roughly eighteen turns.

🔌 THE BRIVITY LANE IS BLOCKED AND THE SOCIAL LANE IS HALF-BLIND — both for the same reason. The 5:06 PM deep sweep logged BLOCKED: the Chrome extension reports no connected browser at all, and six of its seven parts run through that browser. The 5:05 PM engagement run logged PARTIAL for the same cause — zero comments read across sixty-five posts. ⭐ It fell back and validated the outage two independent ways rather than reporting a clean board, which is the right behaviour. One pairing restarts both.

⏰ THE LISTING MILESTONE ENGINE HAS NOT RUN IN TWENTY-ONE HOURS — last stamped 8:05 PM yesterday, against a normal cadence of five times a day. ⭐ IT COST NOTHING TODAY, and that is checkable rather than assumed: the only listing event since then is the third showing booked on 2127 this afternoon, which this run caught directly from the source. But the engine is the thing that would have caught it first, and it was not watching.

callBlock.why: He pulled a value on his own home again at 5:07 this morning — and he has already told you in writing that your estimate reads too low. A seller who argues with your number is a seller who is thinking about selling; this is the freshest one on the board and it is only hours old.

She asked you to call her on August 4th and gave you her cell in the same sentence. Twenty-eight days. It is her second slab leak on a house you sold her, she wanted a name and to tell you the story — and nobody answered. That is a referral being lost in slow motion.

You asked, he answered on 8/27 at 8:00 AM, and the reply has sat unread for five days. His son is mid-decision on the lake property you floated yourself. Short message, live situation, two-minute call.
Your own CRM flags him HOT and his review call has been overdue since March 27. Five months on a lead the system itself marked as your best kind — and nothing about that gets better with age.
A past client — you sold her the house — asking for a valuation on her Fairhope home, overdue since 8/14. Past-client seller asks do not sit for two and a half weeks anywhere else in this business.

Net-new buyer registration on your own site late Monday afternoon, first-touch email out within the half hour. She is still the freshest lead you own and the machine cannot text her — voice is the whole advantage and the advantage decays hourly.
Seller hand-raise on a Chelsea Park address that came in Saturday morning; his first touch went out 7:12 Monday and nobody has spoken to him. Warm today, cold by Thursday.

He left a voicemail from a NEW number Friday afternoon, told you he was in Panama City for the weekend, and asked you to call. Both of his values are finished and staged. He initiated — that is the rarest thing on this list.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE at $999,000 — a THIRD showing booked this afternoon, thirty hours after the cut
listings.note: 🔥 THE PRICE ANSWER KEEPS ANSWERING. At 3:01 this afternoon Ty T. of Keller Williams Homewood booked FRI 9/4 4:30–5:30 PM — his first visit, and a full hour. ⭐ THE COUNTER IS THE WHOLE ARGUMENT: total showings on this house now reads FIVE. It was TWO on Sunday. Three agents have booked since the cut to $999,000 at 7:55 Monday morning, and in the forty days before it the house produced two tours total. 📅 FRIDAY IS NOW A DOUBLE: Sarah J. of ARC Realty–Hoover at 8:30 AM and Ty T. at 4:30 PM. 📞 THE READ THAT MATTERS MOST IS STILL MISSING — Cathy O. of ARC Realty–Hoover walked it Monday 3:45–4:45 PM, the first and only tour at the new number, and has filed nothing in about twenty-five hours. She is the only person alive who has seen this house at $999K. ⚠️ The one written feedback on file calls it “very dated for the asking price” — written three days BEFORE the reprice, with every price field left blank. It is a condition read against an old number. 🎯 The sellers have not been told about Friday's second booking.

listings.status: ⏳ ACTIVE — tour #21 walked THIS AFTERNOON, and the agreement expires 9/8
listings.note: ⏳ SEVEN DAYS TO EXPIRY AND THE FRESHEST SET OF EYES ON THIS HOUSE JUST LEFT IT. Chad B. of RE/MAX Advantage held 4:30–5:30 PM today — his first visit, the twenty-first showing, and he reserved a full hour where most agents here take twenty-five minutes. 📞 HIS READ IS WORTH MORE TONIGHT THAN IT WILL BE TOMORROW. 🔍 THE STANDING FINDING IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS STRONG: two independent brokerages returned the identical verdict — the stairs — and BOTH left every price field blank. Two agents, two offices, one physical objection, zero price objections. ⭐ THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES THIS LISTING EVER DREW is still uncalled: Amy G. of Ethos International filed Interested: YES on 8/16, buyers who had just started looking, house at the top of their list. Sixteen days. ⏳ Cheryl P.'s Saturday read is now about eighty hours overdue — a third stairs verdict before 9/8 is the difference between a fit conversation and a price conversation.

listings.status: 🔴 BACK ON THE MARKET — one real tour on the calendar, tomorrow at 6:00 PM
listings.note: 📅 TOMORROW IS THE LIVE THING. Estacie L. of eXp Realty Central holds WED 9/2 6:00 PM — her first showing of this address and a brokerage that has never touched it. It is the only tour on the house. 🔴 The contract was ruled dead Monday 7:12 AM — financing, not neglect. 🚨 AND THE CORRECTION HELD: the Monday 8:30 AM auto-report promised your seller a Tuesday 9/1 tour that never existed on eight days of receipts — she caught it herself at 11:58 and you closed it by voice the same afternoon. Today is that Tuesday, and it passed with no showing, exactly as the receipts said. 📞 THE CHEAPEST CALL ON THE BOARD IS STILL UNMADE: Davis H. of ARC Realty–Hoover toured 8/27 and has filed nothing for about a hundred and twenty-three hours — and the answer to ‘is it still available’ flipped from no to yes on Monday. That is an update, not a nudge. ⚠️ Machine email to this seller remains stopped by rule — voice only.

✅ THE FILE ADVANCED MONDAY when the lender's appraisal order came through. No value yet — an order is not an opinion, and this board will not report one until a number exists. 🔴 TWO PROMISES ARE OPEN ON THIS FILE AND BOTH ARE YOURS. The first is the inspection call in three piles — fix, credit, decline — which you have now put in writing twice; a seller who hears three piles instead of nineteen items says yes on the phone. 📄 The second is newer and harder to forget: title asked whether Glenn C., on title but not on the contract, would be at closing, and you answered that he has passed and you would provide the death certificate. That certificate is now an undelivered promise on a 9/21 close. 🏆 The hard half is behind you — sixty-three pages read line by line and a written game plan to your sellers before 8:40 AM.

listings.status: 📞 THE ONE THING — he has said twice he never got the report, and the card is still unchecked
listings.note: 📞 THIS IS THE SINGLE ITEM YOU LEFT UNCHECKED ON A SIXTEEN-CHECKOFF DAY, and it is still open at 5:35 PM. He called Monday at 2:44: “Just letting you know I didn't get anything from you.” Five seconds, and the second time he has said it. 🔴 THE MONDAY FIX PROBABLY DID NOT FIX IT — verified inside the thread this morning: the 2:10 PM repair FORWARDED THE SAME HTML that failed the first time. Same format, wrapped in a forwarded-message header. The delivery variable was never actually changed. ⭐ No bounce was ever generated on either send, so nothing in this fleet could have known. 📧 The plain-text version is staged, addressed, and still unsent — it is the only version that changes anything. 🎯 AND THE REAL ARGUMENT WAS NEVER PRICE: your read is mid-to-high $600s on records showing 3,600 square feet, his is near $800K on a house he says is over 4,000. Settle the measurement and the number settles itself — and the re-run comps you promised him are now five days old.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — day 162, agreement expiring, and Friday's read is now about a hundred hours overdue
listings.note: ⚠️ THE DEADLINE IS THE STORY, NOT THE TRAFFIC. The brokerage has flagged this listing agreement as expiring and asked for a seller's-disclosure revision alongside it. 🔴 THE PRICE CONVERSATION YOU TOLD THIS CLIENT YOU OWED HIM ON 8/24 IS STILL OPEN — and an expiring agreement is the cheapest possible moment to have it. ⏳ Alexis L. of RE/MAX Select Partners toured Friday midday, the eleventh tour on this unit, and has filed nothing in about a hundred hours. The access question she asked — Supra or lockbox — still has no answer anywhere on record.

listings.status: ⚠️ ACTIVE — 45 tours, no offer, and nothing on the calendar until 9/12
listings.note: ⚠️ FORTY-FIVE WALKS WITH NO OFFER IS A PRICE STORY WEARING A TRAFFIC STORY'S CLOTHES. The last two written feedbacks both answered “too high” outright — the only listing you own where agents tick that box rather than leave it blank. 📅 WHAT HOLDS: one brand-new agent reserved SAT 9/12 9:00 AM and SUN 9/13 9:00 AM, two consecutive mornings. ⭐ The 8/28 cancellation two minutes before the appointment is not a pricing verdict and this board does not report it as one — the buyer fell in love with another house and never entered this one. 🔍 The one lever nobody has pulled is not a price cut: a pre-inspection, to take the unknowns off the table.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — closes 9/14, thirteen days out
listings.note: ✅ THE FILE IS HEALTHY AND ON SCHEDULE. ⚠️ The inspection requests have now been sitting with your seller since 8/20 — twelve days, and it is paperwork rather than condition. 🎯 Two weeks out is the last comfortable moment to clear paperwork; after that it becomes a rush, and a rush two weeks from a closing is how good files go sideways.

listings.status: ✅ UNDER CONTRACT — roof addendum fully signed, closes 10/23
listings.note: 🎉 BOTH SELLERS HAVE SIGNED and this file has now held steady at inspection through thirteen consecutive engine runs — the quietest file you own. 🔍 Only the escrow holdback sizing remains loose, and it is not urgent at seven weeks out.

listings.status: 📢 COMING SOON — TWO blank weekdays now, and that is the number that changes the read
listings.note: 📢 THE VERDICT THIS BOARD SET FOR ITSELF YESTERDAY HAS NOW ARRIVED. Monday's note said one blank weekday is not a verdict but two in a row means marketing rather than waiting. 🔴 TODAY IS THE SECOND: a fresh fourteen-day pull returns no request, no confirmation and no cancellation on this address — the calendar has been empty since it went live on a Sunday. ⭐ Willow Point is still the argument for patience on this exact point — three days of paid ads with nothing, then five bookings and a signed offer inside eleven days once the market found it. 🎯 But patience was Monday's answer. Today's is a marketing decision.

listings.status: 📅 COMING SOON — 22.63 acres, price ruled at $575K, list date still blank
listings.note: ⏳ THE ANSWER THIS LISTING NEEDED ARRIVED ELEVEN DAYS AGO AND NOBODY PICKED IT UP — your coordinator posted the gate code to the shared board on 8/21 and it has sat with zero comments since. 📋 STILL OPEN BEHIND IT: the perc documentation and the covenants. ⭐ The price is ruled; everything blocking the launch is paperwork and one unread board card.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE at $599K — highest lead yield you own, and the buy-boxes keep sharpening
listings.note: 🔍 THE FURTHEST-ALONG BUYER ANSWERED AND IT IS A NO — he wants un-entitled acreage. ⭐ THAT IS A BUY-BOX, NOT A REJECTION, and it is worth more than a maybe: it tells you which builder profile to stop pitching. 📤 The document package went to a builder on 8/28 and, per your own rule, went without mentioning perc.

listings.status: 🔥 ACTIVE — price cut live, still no tours in the window
listings.note: 🔧 A REAL CATCH MONDAY MORNING, two and a half hours before it published: this listing's branded card had been rendered carrying an overstated sales claim and was attached to a 7:30 AM post. It was re-rendered, re-hosted and the post re-pointed before it fired. ⚠️ WHAT IS STILL YOURS TO FIX: a post from 8/20 still shows the old price, and only you can delete it — the machine cannot reach that account.

listings.status: ✅ CLOSED AND FUNDED — closing #24 of the year, receipted Monday 5:12 PM
listings.note: ✅ IT IS DONE, AND IT IS DONE ON RECEIPTS RATHER THAN OPTIMISM — this board held it at CLOSING for four days after the appointment because nothing said the money had moved, and then two independent sources landed at once. ⭐ THE YEAR READS 24 BECAUSE A RECEIPT ARRIVED, NOT BECAUSE A CALENDAR SAID SO. 🎉 The post-close follow-up sequence is staged and the celebration call is still yours to make. ⚖️ One decision rides on this address and it publishes tomorrow at 1:00 PM — whether the Just Sold post opens with our own forty-four quiet days.

pipeline.paceProjection: ✅ TWENTY-FOUR, AND IT IS STILL RECEIPTED. At day 244, twenty-four closings annualises to about 35.9 — just ABOVE the 35-a-year survive line, where twenty-three annualised to 34.4. One closing was the difference between surviving and not, on paper, and it landed Monday afternoon. ⏳ STILL TWENTY-ONE BEHIND THE 45 GOAL WITH 121 DAYS LEFT, and that is the honest frame: clearing the survive line is not clearing the goal. ⏳ WHAT IS ACTUALLY BEHIND IT: 198 Rena closing 9/21 with the appraisal now ordered, 3350 Altamont on 9/14, and 1709 Fieldstone on 10/23. 🔴 ANYTHING CLOSING INSIDE 2026 MUST BE UNDER CONTRACT BY ROUGHLY OCT 31 — eight and a half weeks from today, and the pipeline lost a file on Monday when the Willow Point contract was ruled dead, which returns that house to the active column and out of the forecast. ⚠️ Monday's 5:51 AM forecast was derived BEFORE both of those changes — treat it as one file high and one closing light until the next run re-derives it, and note the weekly forecast has not re-run since. 👥 Team pace reads 37 on the latest verified sheet; that sheet counts against 80, not the 90 carried here, and the discrepancy still has not been reconciled.

money.note: 🔴 THE FAILURE SPREAD TO A THIRD PLACE TODAY, AND THIS ONE HAS TEETH. At 9:49 this morning Google declined the card behind your Workspace account — the account that runs your business email domain. ⭐ THAT IS THE SAME CARD THAT BOUNCED AN AUTOPAY OVERNIGHT, so this is not a one-off decline; it is the second refusal on the same card inside nine hours, and the first one that threatens infrastructure rather than a bill. 🔴 IT IS ALSO NO LONGER JUST A CHECKING PROBLEM: the third returned item in eight days hit the personal account overnight, on top of two other failed auto-payments. Three declines in one night, across two instruments. ⚠️ THE UTILITY BILL WAS DUE TODAY AND NOTHING CONFIRMS IT EITHER WAY — no payment confirmation, no withdrawal notice, no receipt anywhere in the mailbox, searched twice. ⏱️ AND THE CASH POSITION IS FORMALLY UNKNOWN, not low: neither account has been bank-stamped inside twenty-four hours, and by this desk's own rule that makes it unknown. 🎯 Opening both registers yourself remains the single highest-value five minutes on this board — no routine can see inside those accounts, and the accounting system's own cash figure has been guard-tripped for sixteen straight runs.

isa.decayPolicy: 🔍 60 OPEN ROWS IN THE CALL LANE, UP FROM 53 LAST NIGHT — and the direction is the finding. Fifty-five of them are due today or already overdue, and TWENTY-ONE sit at p1. ⭐ THE PILE IS PEOPLE, NOT NOISE: named human beings with phone numbers who raised a hand about one of YOUR listings, or past clients who asked you a direct question. 🔴 THE OLDEST p1 IS ELEVEN DAYS OLD and the worst one is a past client who asked for a call on August 4th — twenty-eight days — about her second slab leak on a house you sold her. 📈 SEVEN NET-NEW ROWS LANDED OVERNIGHT from the database sweep, every one of them old work surfaced late rather than new demand. 🎯 A ONE-WORD RULING IS STILL WAITING ON YOU about whether this board should auto-expire at all — asked 8/16, and the pile has roughly tripled since. Sixteen days of not answering is itself an answer this board keeps having to work around.
isa.sweepCadence: ⏸️ NORMALLY EVERY TWENTY TO THIRTY MINUTES WHILE THE FLEET IS UP — TODAY IT RAN FOUR TIMES AND STOPPED AT 7:40 AM. 🔴 That is roughly eighteen missed turns across the working day, and it is the same nine-hour dark window that took the whole fleet down: routines do not run while the app is closed. ✅ WHAT THE FOUR MORNING RUNS DID DO, before the lights went out: staged a re-engagement, caught two follow-up twins that a five-message search cap had hidden, and shipped call artifacts on nine of the ten live hand-raisers. 🔧 THE BUILD YOU APPROVED MONDAY AT 4:16 IS IN FORCE AND HELD ALL MORNING: every call task this lane creates now ships with a tap-to-call link, a pre-written opening text in your voice, and a staged draft where an email exists — a call task with none of the three may no longer be created. ⚠️ Two lanes are still blocked underneath all of it: the seller-import session is signed out, and the browser this lane needs for the CRM is unpaired.
